name: bot-mtg-new
description: Capital.com SDD-M15 scanner with Angular dashboard (one web dyno).

TZ.description: Timezone for the M15 scheduler and Warsaw 21:00 PP roll.

BROKER.description: SPI adapter: capital (demo + live beans) or paper (in-process stub).

EXECUTION_ENABLED.description: false = scan + dashboard + webhooks only. true = may place orders.

CAPITAL_API_KEY.description: Capital.com DEMO API key (or CAPITAL_DEMO_API_KEY). Never commit this.

CAPITAL_EMAIL.description: Capital.com DEMO login email (also used as LIVE email fallback).

CAPITAL_API_PASSWORD.description: Capital.com DEMO API key custom password.

CAPITAL_LIVE_API_KEY.description: Capital.com LIVE API key. App boots if unset; Live pane shows disconnected.

CAPITAL_LIVE_EMAIL.description: Capital.com LIVE login email. Falls back to CAPITAL_EMAIL.

CAPITAL_LIVE_PASSWORD.description: Capital.com LIVE API key custom password (alias CAPITAL_LIVE_API_PASSWORD).

AGENT_SIGNAL_WEBHOOK_URLS.description: Comma-separated URLs. JSON posted on new full stack, HA flip, failover, or scan_ok.

AGENT_SIGNAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Cursor automation sender key. Set on the host only. Never commit.
